This Feature Service displays the boundaries and types of the Forest Management Prescription areas within the Monongahela, George Washington and Jefferson National Forests. The data reflects that shown in their respective Forest Management Plans.<\/span><\/p>

Source and Date:<\/span><\/p>

GW and JNF prescriptions received from James O'Hear of GWJNF in Feb of 2015.<\/span><\/p>

MNF prescriptions received from Rick Webb in a FOIA package he received from MNF, also in Feb of 2015.<\/span><\/p>

Purpose:<\/span><\/p>

Management prescriptions detail the intended land use of National Forests. The goal is typically for conservation, ecosystem health, biodiversity, recreation, and more. By detailing these areas, protecting land is more organized and efficient.<\/span><\/p>

Processing:<\/span><\/p>

The received shapefiles were Merged into a single shapefile (native fields preserved), and imported into ArcGIS to create this feature service.<\/span><\/p>

Symbolization:<\/span><\/p>

Monongahela<\/span><\/p>

  • MP 3.0: teal polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

  • MP 4.1: greenish yellow polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

  • MP 5.0: dark green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

  • MP 6.1: gray polygon <\/span><\/p><\/li>

  • MP 6.2: light blue polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

  • MP 8.0: green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li><\/ul>

    George Washington<\/span><\/p>

    • 1A - Designated Wilderness: dark green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 1B - Recommended Wilderness: green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 2C2 - Scenic River: blue polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 2C3 - Recreational River: blue polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4A - Appalachian Trail Corridor: yellow polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4B - Research Natural Area: beige polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4C1 - Geologic Area: beige polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4D - Special Biological Area: beige polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4D1 - Peters Mountain Old Growth: beige polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4F - National Scenic Area: muted dark green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 4FA - Proposed National Scenic Area: muted light green polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 5A - Administrative Site: red-orange polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 5B - Communication Site: red-orange polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 5C - Special Use/Utility: red-orange polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 7A1 - Scenic Byway: orange polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>

    • 7B - Scenic Corridor and Viewshed: orange polygon<\/span><\/p><\/li>
